svg.title: Updated pipeline: 10 m to 40 m pair generation, latent processing with feature fusion, and composite loss
svg.desc: A 10 m Sentinel-2 tile is blurred, downsampled by 4 and noised to a 40 m input. Latent processing and hand-crafted feature fusion occur on the low-resolution grid, then pixel-shuffle upsamples by 4. The output is compared with the 10 m target using L1, SAM, MS-SSIM and gradient losses.
svg.text: Composite loss: SR vs 10 m target
